title: Ignore this common resume tip...
description:
There’s a lot of resume advice out there but how much of it is actually good? You’ll see a lot of talk about the “1-page resume” being the a fixed guideline but there are many instances where you’ll need more than that. If you’re deeper into your career you will probably have enough YOE to fill that first page, you do want to include other important sections like a skills section and professional summary, and it’s not worth shrinking your font to a unreadable size in order to fit everything in 1 page. #resumeadvice #resumetips #resumewriting #jobseeker #jobsearch
